Package es.uib.lotery

package es.uib.lotery
  • Related Packages

  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Client
    The Client class represents an object-oriented lottery client that interacts with the DNS and Seller servers to participate in lottery draws.
    ClientSocket
    The ClientSocket class represents the entry point for running a lottery client that repeatedly participates in lottery draws.
    DNS
    The DNS class serves as the entry point for launching the DNSSocket server in the lottery network.
    DNSSocket
    The DNSSocket class represents a lightweight DNS-like service used within the lottery system for service discovery and registration.
    Seller
    Represents a lottery seller node responsible for: Registering and unregistering itself with a DNS service. Handling client requests for lottery draws (sorteos). Communicating with the main lottery server to process requests.
    SellerSocket
    The SellerSocket class is the main entry point for starting a lottery seller client.
    Server
    The Server class represents the central lottery server responsible for generating and validating winning numbers in the lottery system.
    ServerSocket
    The ServerSocket class is the entry point for starting the main lottery server that handles incoming lottery draw requests from sellers.
